note: Limits behind wf status, wf summary and wf files. Minutes unless the name says otherwise.
charsPerTokenMeaning: wf files estimates the tokens of a tool result as its characters over this ratio. Measured with the o200k tokenizer over this repository's src, docs and test on 2026-09-30.
sizeBandMeaning: S is peak context under sizeBandSMaxTokens. M is from sizeBandSMaxTokens to under sizeBandMMaxTokens. L is from sizeBandMMaxTokens through contextBudgetTokens inclusive. A higher peak is over budget.

statusMeaning.window: a session is listed when it had an event this recently
statusMeaning.quiet: an open turn with no event for this long is stuck
statusMeaning.tool: a shell or other tool running this long is stuck
statusMeaning.repeat: the same shell command this often among the hour's last 20 tool calls
statusMeaning.failed: failed tool calls among the hour's last 10
statusMeaning.costPerHourUsd: API-equivalent cost in the last hour
